Oud is one of the most talked-about notes in perfume: deep, woody and a little smoky. Designer houses such as Tom Ford, Gucci, Guerlain and Chopard each have their own take on it. Here is what oud is, how the best-known oud perfumes differ, and how to choose and wear one.

What is oud?

Oud, also called agarwood or aoud, is a dark, fragrant resin that forms in the wood of agar (Aquilaria) trees. It has been treasured in the Middle East and South Asia for centuries, burned as incense and worn as an oil. Natural oud is rare, so many modern perfumes use an oud accord: a blend of woods, resins and leathery notes built to give the same rich effect. Gucci, for example, lists an oud accord in its base notes.

Tom Ford Oud Wood

Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau de Parfum (30ml or 50ml) is the gentlest way into oud. Its key notes are oud wood, rosewood and cardamom over sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean and amber, so the oud reads smooth and warm rather than smoky. It is unisex and easy to wear in the office or in the evening. See every Tom Ford fragrance, or read our Tom Ford perfume guide for Black Orchid, Noir Extreme and Neroli Portofino.

Gucci Intense Oud

Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum (90ml) is darker. Black pepper and olibanum (frankincense) open it; amber woods, sandalwood and cedarwood sit at the heart; leather, patchouli, gurjun balsam and the oud accord form the base. Expect incense and leather more than sweetness. Shop all Gucci, or compare it with Bloom, Flora Gorgeous and Guilty in our Gucci perfume guide.

Tom Ford Oud Wood or Gucci Intense Oud?

  • Choose Oud Wood if you want a soft, creamy wood with a touch of spice that suits everyday wear.
  • Choose Intense Oud if you like incense, leather and a bolder, smokier trail for evenings and colder months.

Three more oud perfumes

  • Guerlain Oud Essentiel (125ml): saffron and pelargonium, then rose, oud and cedarwood over leather, frankincense and guaiac wood. A rose-and-leather oud, made unisex. Every Guerlain we stock is in our Guerlain perfume guide.
  • Chopard Oud Malaki (80ml): grapefruit, lavender and artemisia, then tobacco, spices and leather over oud, ambergris and dark woods. Made for men, and the most affordable oud in this guide.
  • Montale Aoud Damascus (100ml): damask rose, aoud and saffron with amber, woods and musk. Montale is known for rose and oud, and this one is made for women.

The Al Haramain Amber Oud editions

Al Haramain's Amber Oud range is a popular Arabian line, but read the notes: not every edition is built around oud. Our Amber Oud editions guide compares them all. Armaf Club de Nuit Intense, with agarwood (oud) in its base, is in our Armaf Club de Nuit guide. Amber Oud White Edition is bergamot and orange, then jasmine, rose and freesia over musk, vanilla and patchouli, and is listed for women. Amber Oud Carbon Edition is a fresh, aromatic men's scent of lavender, rosemary, bergamot, sage and vetiver. Amber Oud Bleu Edition is citrus and mint over incense, vetiver and sandalwood. For the Gold, Ruby, Tobacco and Black editions, and for Lattafa, read our guide to Arabian perfume and Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa.

Which oud perfume suits you?

  • New to oud: Tom Ford Oud Wood, or a fresher Amber Oud edition.
  • You love incense and leather: Gucci Intense Oud or Guerlain Oud Essentiel.
  • You love rose: Montale Aoud Damascus or Guerlain Oud Essentiel.
  • Warm and spicy: Chopard Oud Malaki.

Oud is traditionally unisex, so "for men" or "for women" on the label is only a starting point. Browse unisex perfume, perfume for men and perfume for women.

How to wear oud

  1. Start small: one or two sprays. Oud notes are rich, and a little goes a long way.
  2. Apply to moisturised skin on the wrists, neck or chest. Our guide to layering oud with body butter explains why.
  3. Let it settle: do not rub your wrists together. Oud perfumes often change a lot after the first half hour, so judge them later in the day.
  4. Test before you buy a full bottle if you can, or start with a smaller size.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum is the most common strength for oud perfumes; read extrait vs eau de parfum for what the label means.
  • Patch test on your inner arm if you have sensitive skin, and keep perfume away from your eyes.
  • Store bottles away from heat and sunlight, with the cap on.

Shop every oud perfume, all Arabian perfume and niche perfume, all 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK.

Al Haramain's Amber Oud is a family of eau de parfums rather than a single scent. Each edition has its own colour and its own character, from the sweet, fruity Gold to the spiced Tobacco and the fresh, herbal Carbon. Here is every Al Haramain Amber Oud edition we stock, side by side, with its notes, sizes and the kind of person it suits.

Is there oud in Amber Oud?

Amber Oud is the name of the line. The note lists we hold for these editions do not name oud: they are built on amber, woods, musk, vanilla and resins, with fruit, flowers, spice or herbs on top depending on the edition. If you want a perfume that puts oud at the centre, read our oud perfume guide. If you want a warm, amber-led scent with an Arabian feel, read on.

Sweet and fruity: the original and the Gold Edition

Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (60ml, 100ml or 200ml) opens with bergamot and green notes, moves into melon, pineapple, amber and sweet notes, and dries down to vanilla, musk and woods. It is the edition to choose if you like sweet, golden, fruity scents.

The original Al Haramain Amber Oud (60ml) carries the same note list in our listings: bergamot and green notes, then amber, melon, pineapple and sweet notes, then vanilla, musk and woods. The brand sells them as separate editions, so expect them to be close relatives.

For a stronger version, Amber Oud Extreme Gold Edition (60ml or 100ml) is an extrait de parfum with the same listed notes. An extrait has a higher concentration of fragrance oils than an eau de parfum; our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.

Warm and spiced: Ruby, Tobacco and Black

  • Amber Oud Ruby Edition (100ml, 120ml or 200ml): saffron and bitter almond, then jasmine and cedarwood, over ambergris, woods and musk. Spiced, nutty and floral, a smooth choice for evenings.
  • Amber Oud Tobacco Edition (60ml): tobacco leaf, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger, then vanilla, clove, star anise, cacao and tonka bean, over tobacco, dried fruits and woods. The richest and sweetest of the spiced editions, made for winter nights.
  • Amber Oud Black Edition (100ml): cardamom, grapefruit and lavender, then leather, amber and orange blossom, over benzoin, ambergris and vetiver. Darker and drier, with a leather heart.

Fresh and woody: Bleu and Carbon

  • Amber Oud Bleu Edition (60ml, 100ml or 200ml): grapefruit, lemon, mint and pink pepper, then ginger, nutmeg and jasmine, over incense, vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, patchouli, labdanum and white musk. Crisp at the start and woody underneath, easy to wear all year.
  • Amber Oud Carbon Edition (60ml, 100ml or 200ml): lavender, rosemary and bergamot, then sage, cedarwood and geranium, over vetiver, musk, amber and moss. A clean, herbal scent sold as a men's fragrance, good for the office.

Floral: the White Edition

Amber Oud White Edition (60ml, 100ml or 200ml) is sold as a women's fragrance: bergamot and orange, then jasmine, rose and freesia, over musk, vanilla and patchouli. It is the lightest and most floral of the family, an easy pick for daytime.

Which Amber Oud edition should you choose?

  • You like sweet, fruity scents: Gold Edition, or Extreme Gold for a richer version.
  • You want something warm for winter: Tobacco Edition or Ruby Edition.
  • You like leather and dry woods: Black Edition.
  • You want a fresh everyday scent: Bleu Edition, or Carbon for a herbal, barbershop style.
  • You prefer florals: White Edition.

Most editions are unisex; Carbon is sold for men and White for women, but wear whichever you like. Prefer amber without the fruit? The sister scent Al Haramain Amber Musk (100ml) is amber and floral notes over musk, woods, vanilla and resins.

How to wear it

These are full, warm eau de parfums, so start with a spray or two on the neck and wrists rather than a cloud. They sit well on moisturised skin; our guide to layering oud with body butter shows how. For the wider family of Arabian scents, see our Arabian perfume guide.

Good to know

  • Sizes vary by edition: Gold, Bleu, Carbon and White come in 60ml, 100ml and 200ml; check each listing for the size you want.
  • As a gift: the warmer editions make a generous Christmas present. See our perfume gift sets guide for more ideas.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Shop every Al Haramain fragrance, browse Arabian perfume and oud perfume, or see our amber fragrances.

A perfume gift set is the easiest way to give someone a scent they already love, with something extra in the box: a travel spray, a matching body lotion or a few miniatures. This guide is our pick of the perfume gift sets in stock for Christmas 2026, sorted by who you are buying for and what you want to spend. Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK.

How to choose a perfume gift set

  • You know their perfume: buy the set of that scent. A full bottle with a travel spray or lotion costs little more than the bottle alone.
  • You know the brand, not the scent: a miniature set lets them try several perfumes from the same house.
  • You know neither: choose a discovery set, then they can buy the full bottle of the one they like.

Perfume gift sets for her

Full-bottle sets, from the biggest box down:

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set: 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and a 100ml body lotion. A creamy white floral of jasmine and tuberose.
  • Chloé Nomade Gift Set: a 75ml eau de parfum and a 20ml travel spray. Mirabelle plum, freesia and oakmoss, a floral chypre that suits the office as well as an evening out. More in our Chloé perfume guide.
  • Dolce & Gabbana The One for Women Gift Set: two 50ml bottles of a fruity amber floral with peach, lychee, jasmine and vanilla. One for home, one for her bag. Our Dolce & Gabbana perfume guide compares the whole range.
  • Elie Saab Le Parfum Lumière Gift Set: 90ml eau de parfum, a 10ml spray and a 75ml body lotion, with orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose. Our Elie Saab perfume guide compares the whole range.
  • Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Gift Set: 50ml eau de parfum with a 50ml body lotion. Lilac, rose and violet over patchouli. Every Gucci scent we stock is in our Gucci perfume guide.
  • Elie Saab Girl of Now Lovely Gift Set: 50ml eau de parfum and a 75ml body lotion, a sweeter scent of red berries, rose, almond and vanilla.

Miniature sets, for trying a whole range: Chloé Women’s Miniature Set (4 x 5ml), Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Set (5 x 4.5ml), Marc Jacobs Daisy and Perfect Miniature Set, Dolce & Gabbana Women’s Miniature Set with Devotion, Q, Blue Jasmine, The One and Light Blue, and DKNY Delicious Miniature Set (4 x 7ml). See them all in perfume gift sets for her. What is inside each one is in our mini perfume sets guide. For Mugler Alien and Angel, see our Mugler perfume guide, and for the Narciso Rodriguez 10ml sprays, our Narciso Rodriguez perfume guide. Marc Jacobs Perfect and Daisy are compared in our Marc Jacobs perfume guide.

Aftershave gift sets for him

  • Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum 100ml + 10ml: bergamot and Sichuan pepper over vanilla and ambroxan. If you only know he likes a fresh, popular scent, this is the safe choice. Our Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum guide explains the versions.
  • Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence 100ml + 15ml: juniper, ginger and geranium over clean woods. Crisp and easy to wear every day.
  • Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence 100ml + 15ml: citron and calamansi over vetiver, orris and an earthy, resinous base. Our Bvlgari perfume guide compares the Essence sets.
  • Bvlgari Man Wood Essence 100ml + 15ml: citrus, coriander, cypress and vetiver, a green woody scent.
  • Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Gift Set: a 100ml eau de toilette and two 10ml travel sprays, with bergamot, lavender and a moss liquor accord.
  • Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 50ml + 5ml: blood orange, lemon and juniper, then sage and lavender over cedarwood.

For a man who likes to switch, the Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Set holds Devotion, K in two versions, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme. More in aftershave gift sets for him. Choosing between 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom? See our Paco Rabanne perfume guide, or for Versace Eros, our Versace perfume guide. For Bad Boy and 212, see our Carolina Herrera perfume guide.

Discovery sets for anyone

When you do not know their taste, a discovery set is the kindest gift. Dior Iconics Mini Set (5 x 5ml) has J’adore, Miss Dior, Hypnotic Poison and Sauvage. Hermès Miniature Set (4 x 7.5ml) holds four unisex scents from the Jardins collection. Chopard Gardens of Paradise (4 x 10ml) holds Orange Mauresque, Miel d’Arabie, Jasmin Moghol and Rose Seljuke, and Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo (3 x 12ml) three bright Mediterranean scents. Our Acqua di Parma guide lists what is in both its discovery sets. Not sure what EDP or EDT means on the box? Read extrait vs eau de parfum.

Perfume gift sets under £30

  • Korloff Paris Discovery Set (3 x 10ml): three women’s scents, from fresh and fruity to soft and warm.
  • Trussardi Pure Jasmine Gift Set: a 60ml eau de parfum plus 10ml and 7ml minis, jasmine with bergamot, pistachio and vanilla. For a full-size bottle on a budget, see our Lalique perfume guide.
  • Trussardi Ruby Red Gift Set: a 60ml eau de parfum with a 125ml body emulsion.
  • Single 10ml minis in a gift-ready size: Gucci Bloom Parfum for her, Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum or Calvin Klein Defy Parfum for him.

For more under a budget, see gifts under £50 and gifts under £25, or our Christmas gift guide for skincare too. For small gifts, read stocking fillers for her under £25.

Good to know

  • Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK.
  • UK delivery is free on orders over £40, and orders over £70 get £5 off with code SAVE5 at checkout. Shopping around Black Friday? Our Black Friday edit gathers in-stock gift sets in one place.
  • We hold limited stock of each set, so buy early if you have one in mind.

Oud perfume is built around agarwood, a dark, resinous material with a smoky, woody depth that lasts for hours on skin. This edit brings together oud fragrances from Arabian, niche and designer houses, so you can find the style that suits you.

Arabian oud

Al Haramain's Amber Oud family is the easiest way in: the Gold Edition is rich and sweet, Tobacco is warm and smoky, and Black is deep and bold. Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Royale softens oud with saffron, rose and praline, and Rihanah Ajwaa Oud is an easy, low-cost way to try the note. Fumeri and SAP pair oud with saffron.

Niche and designer oud

Montale's Aoud Safran and Aoud Damascus blend oud with saffron and rose, Mancera Black Noir is dark and rich, and Tiziana Terenzi Caput Mundi and Gold Rose Oudh are concentrated extraits. From the designer houses, Gucci Intense Oud, Guerlain Oud Essentiel, Chopard Oud Malaki and Tom Ford Oud Wood are smoother takes on the note, and Franck Olivier's Parisian Oud and Sun Royal Oud are good-value options.

More oud to explore

Several Arabian houses use oud inside sweeter blends: try Afnan Supremacy Gold, Armaf Club de Nuit Intense or Lattafa for amber, coffee and spice. Oud is strong, so start with one or two sprays on the wrists or neck. Explore the oud fragrances family and our Arabian perfume page. Every bottle is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
